question: What is Cloudflare Registrar's per-TLD transfer price for .com, .org, .net, .xyz, .cc and .vip, and does a first-party source (the public domain search session or the account API) confirm the cfdomainpricing.com registration and renewal figures?
why: Cloudflare publishes no per-TLD list; its public search prices names over a live session the lane tools cannot read, so the per-TLD rows stay reported and transfer prices stay unverified
